messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Be concise and accurate.

List all products. For each product, call get_recommendations. For each recommendation returned, call get_product to fetch its details. Build a nested JSON object of product -> recommendations -> recommendation-details. If total tool calls exceed 30, stop early and report how far you got.

{"id": "9SIQT8TOJO", "name": "Optical Tube Assembly", "description": "Capturing impressive deep-sky astroimages is easier than ever with Rowe-Ackermann Schmidt Astrograph (RASA) V2, the perfect companion to today's top DSLR or astronomical CCD cameras.
